entities.summary: Cheick Tidiane Seck is a Malian musician, arranger and composer. He has written for and played with African artists including Fela Kuti, Mory Kanté, Salif Keita, Youssou N'Dour and for jazz bands. He has also collaborated with musicians Damon Albarn and Mamadou Diabate.
